name: Melbourne Trilogy Upstairs 2022
information: This is a series competition alongside [Melbourne Trilogy Saturday 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MelbourneTrilogySaturday2022#general-info) and [Melbourne Trilogy Sunday 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MelbourneTrilogySunday2022). You will be permitted to compete at **ONLY ONE** of the three competitions. If you register for more than one, your registration will only be accepted for one of the competitions. Please note that each competition has a different set of events. ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!
